text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Reconfirming race information—1,800 meters on turf, 310-meter-long straight with a steep incline of 2.2 meters before the finish line.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I acknowledge that these conditions would have provided a stiff challenge for me in my pre-debut state, but now…
choice_data_list: Now you can handle it for sure!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Indeed, the probability of a winning outcome continues to rise.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I will do my best to get through today's 1,800-meter race as preparation for the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Should I fail to do that… then perhaps it would be wiser to change the direction of our future plans.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can feel the resolve in Mihono Bourbon's quiet ultimatum.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Spring Stakes, which serves as a stepping stone for the Satsuki Sho, is about to begin!
